archetypes.name: dyn-auto-compose
archetypes.rationale: verify trailer splitting and Testing strategy extraction handle edge cases
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the _auto_compose_plan_md function in python/design_lifecycle.py. Focus on: correct split of diff_lines/optional trailer lines from the plan body, Testing strategy section extraction under various heading levels, and the fallback path when plan.txt is absent or unreadable. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
